          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199,
            "text": "    p = c.beginPath()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200,

            "text": "  const col = parseInt(el.dataset.col, 10);"

            "text": "  const fromRef = {"

          },

            "text": "  if (ev.altKey || ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey || ev.type === \"contextmenu\") {"

          },

          {
            "lineNumber": 970,
            "text": "  if (!isMemberFp) {"

            "text": "    const existingId = panel.childByRef \u0026\u0026 panel.childByRef[refKey(fromRef)];"

          },

            "lineNumber": 974
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 975,
            "text": "  let cands = [];"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 976,
            "text": "  try {"

            "text": "      const receiver = el.dataset.receiver || \"\";"

          {

          {

            "text": "        cands = await api(\"/api/resolve_call\", {"

          {
            "lineNumber": 988,
            "text": "      } else {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 989,

          {

            "text": "class CAdapter(TreeSitterAdapter, LanguageAdapter):"

          {
            "lineNumber": 376,
            "text": "def _symbol_from_macro(self, source: bytes, rel_path: str, node) -\u003e Symbol | None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 396,
            "text": ","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 397,
            "text": "        )"

            "lineNumber": 398
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 399,
            "text": "    # --- 引用提取 ---"

          {
            "lineNumber": 400
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 401,
            "text": "    def extract_references("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 402,

          },
          {

            "text": "        seen: set[tuple[str, int, int]] = set()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 408,
            "text": "        for node in self.walk(tree.root_node):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 409,
            "text": "            if node.type != \"call_expression\":"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 410,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 411,
            "text": "            if not self.overlaps(node, start_line, end_line):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 412,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 413,
            "text": "            fn = node.child_by_field_name(\"function\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 414,
            "text": "            if fn is None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 415,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 416,
            "text": "            ref_kind = \"direct\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 417,
            "text": "            receiver = \"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 418,
            "text": "            name_node = fn"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 419,
            "text": "            if fn.type == \"identifier\":"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 420,
            "text": "                name = self.node_text(source, fn)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 421,
            "text": "            elif fn.type == \"field_expression\":"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 422,
            "text": "                # cmd_table[i].handler(args)：函数指针成员调用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 423,
            "text": "                field = fn.child_by_field_name(\"field\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 424,
            "text": "                if field is None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 425,
            "text": "                    continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 426,
            "text": "                name_node = field"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 427,
            "text": "                name = self.node_text(source, field)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 428,
            "text": "                recv = self._root_identifier_from_expr("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 429,
            "text": "                    fn.child_by_field_name(\"argument\"), source"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 430,
            "text": "                )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 431,
            "text": "                if not recv:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 432,
            "text": "                    continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 433,
            "text": "                ref_kind = \"member\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 434,
            "text": "                receiver = recv"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 435,
            "text": "            else:"
          },

            "lineNumber": 436,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 437,
            "text": "            if not name or name in _C_NON_CALLS:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 438,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 439,
            "text": "            line = name_node.start_point[0] + 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 440,
            "text": "            col = name_node.start_point[1] + 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 441,
            "text": "            end_col = name_node.end_point[1] + 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 442,
            "text": "            key = (name, line, col, ref_kind, receiver)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 443,
            "text": "            if key in seen:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 444,
            "text": "                continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 445,
            "text": "            seen.add(key)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 446,
            "text": "            refs.append("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 447,
            "text": "                Reference("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 448,
            "text": "                    name=name,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 449,
            "text": "                    line=line,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 450,
            "text": "                    col=col,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 451,
            "text": "                    end_col=end_col,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 452,
            "text": "                    ref_kind=ref_kind,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 453,
            "text": "                    receiver=receiver,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 454,
            "text": "                )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 455,
            "text": "            )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 456
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 457,
            "text": "        refs.sort(key=lambda r: (r.line, r.col))"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 458,
            "text": "        return refs"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 459
          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 1453,
            "text": "/*"

          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 97,
            "text": "class AsmAdapter(LanguageAdapter):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "def extract_symbols(self, source: bytes, rel_path: str) -\u003e list[Symbol]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137,
            "text": "        for i, (name, start, sig) in enumerate(entries):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 138,
            "text": "            end = ends.get(name)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139,
            "text": "            if end is None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 140,
            "text": "                if i + 1 \u003c len(entry_lines):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141,
            "text": "                    end = max(start, entry_lines[i + 1] - 1)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142,
            "text": "                else:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143,
            "text": "                    end = len(lines) if lines else start"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144,
            "text": "            symbols.append("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 145,
            "text": "                Symbol("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146,
            "text": "                    name=name,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 147,
            "text": "                    kind=\"function\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148,
            "text": "                    file=rel_path,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149,
            "text": "                    start_line=start,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150,
            "text": "                    end_line=end,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151,
            "text": "                    signature=sig[:160],"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152,
            "text": "                    doc=\"\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153,
            "text": "                )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154,
            "text": "            )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155,
            "text": "        return symbols"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157,
            "text": "    def extract_references("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158,
            "text": "        self, source: bytes, rel_path: str, start_line: int, end_line: int"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159,
            "text": "    ) -\u003e list[Reference]:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160,
            "text": "        text = source.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": "        lines = text.splitlines()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162,
            "text": "        if not lines:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "            return []"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165,
            "text": "        # 只解析目标行区间，保留全局行号"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166,
            "text": "        chunk_start = max(0, start_line - 1)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167,
            "text": "        chunk_end = min(len(lines), end_line)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168,
            "text": "        refs: list[Reference] = []"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "        seen: set[tuple[str, int, int]] = set()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "        def _scan_line(line: str, line_no: int, pattern: re.Pattern[str]) -\u003e None:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172,
            "text": "            for m in pattern.finditer(line):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "                name = m.group(1)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174,
            "text": "                if not name or name in _ASM_SKIP:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175,
            "text": "                    continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "                col = m.start(1) + 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177,
            "text": "                key = (name, line_no, col)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "                if key in seen:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "                    continue"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180,
            "text": "                seen.add(key)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181,
            "text": "                refs.append("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "                    Reference("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183,
            "text": "                        name=name,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184,
            "text": "                        line=line_no,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "                        col=col,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "                        end_col=col + len(name),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "                        ref_kind=\"direct\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "                        receiver=\"\","
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189,
            "text": "                    )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "                )"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192,
            "text": "        for i in range(chunk_start, chunk_end):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "            line = lines[i]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194,
            "text": "            line_no = i + 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "            _scan_line(line, line_no, _CALL_RE)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "            _scan_line(line, line_no, _BRANCH_RE)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 198,
            "text": "        return refs"
          }

      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1738,
            "text": "// 将一行按标识符分词：每个标识符包成可点击 span（调用蓝色，其余中性）"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 1739,
            "text": "function renderLine(text, callColMap, lineNo) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1740,
            "text": "  let html = \"\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1741,
            "text": "  let cursor = 0;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1742,
            "text": "  const re = /[A-Za-z_]\\w*/g;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1743,
            "text": "  let m;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1744,
            "text": "  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1745,
            "text": "    const s = m.index, word = m[0], col = s + 1;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1746,
            "text": "    html += escapeHtml(text.slice(cursor, s));"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1747,
            "text": "    cursor = s + word.length;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1748,
            "text": "    if (KEYWORDS.has(word)) { html += escapeHtml(word); continue; }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1749,
            "text": "    const meta = callColMap \u0026\u0026 callColMap.get(col);"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1750,
            "text": "    const isCall = !!meta;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1751,
            "text": "    let cls = isCall ? \"ref\" : \"tok\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1752,
            "text": "    if (meta \u0026\u0026 meta.ref_kind === \"member\") cls += \" ref-member\";"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1753,
            "text": "    let attrs = &#96;data-name=\"${escapeHtml(word)}\" data-line=\"${lineNo}\" data-col=\"${col}\"&#96;;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1754,
            "text": "    if (meta \u0026\u0026 meta.receiver) {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1755,
            "text": "      attrs += &#96; data-receiver=\"${escapeHtml(meta.receiver)}\" data-ref-kind=\"member\"&#96;;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1756,
            "text": "    }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1757,
            "text": "    html += &#96;\u003cspan class=\"${cls}\" ${attrs}\u003e${escapeHtml(word)}\u003c/span\u003e&#96;;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1758,
            "text": "  }"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1759,
            "text": "  html += escapeHtml(text.slice(cursor));"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1760,
            "text": "  return html;"
          },
          {
            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 1761,
            "text": "}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1762
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 1763,
            "text": "/** 在父面板 DOM 中定位来源 token（优先 line+col，退回同行同名） */"

已修复面板间连线的**颜色**与**方向**，按语义区分四种关系：

| 关系 | 颜色 | 方向 | 触发方式 |
|------|------|------|----------|
| **调用** | 蓝色 `#58a6ff` | 父 → 子（A 调用 B） | 点击蓝色函数调用 |
| **引用** | 绿色 `#3fb950` | 父 → 子（A 引用 B） | 点击变量/类型等 `.tok` |
| **查用法** | 紫色 `#d2a8ff` | 子 → 父（B 使用 A，箭头指向定义） | Alt/Ctrl+点击 → 选用法 |
| **搜索/关联** | 橙色 `#ffb14d` 虚线 | 父 → 子 | 符号搜索挂到当前树 |

### 主要改动

1. **`navFromToken`**：区分 `refKind` 为 `call` 或 `reference`，不再混用空字符串。
2. **`openUsageRow` / `openSearchUsage`**：连线锚点改到**子面板用法行**；`defRef` 指向**父面板定义处**；箭头从用法处指回定义（方向正确）。
3. **`drawConnectors` / `decorate`**：按 `classifyLink()` 选颜色、方向和高亮位置；查用法时同时高亮用法 token 与定义 token。
4. **`style.css`**：新增 `--link-*` 变量与对应样式类。

请**强制刷新**页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）后再试。若已有保存的标签页是旧格式，查用法连线可能仍按旧逻辑显示；重新走一遍「查用法 → 点开用法行」即可得到正确的紫色反向箭头。
